title: 听力挑战 · 学术演讲

rounds.speaker: 演讲者
rounds.line: Today I will present the findings of our study, which examine the effects of sleep on memory consolidation in young adults.
rounds.lineCn: 今天我将介绍我们研究的发现,该研究考察睡眠对年轻人记忆巩固的影响。

grammar.name: 学术演讲开头句式
grammar.note: present the findings of our study + 非限制性定语从句补充研究对象,是演讲开场的标准学术句式。

options.text: The talk focuses on how sleep affects memory consolidation.
options.feedback: 演讲主题是睡眠对记忆巩固的影响。

options.text: The talk focuses on diet and exercise among children.
options.feedback: 演讲对象是睡眠与记忆,不是饮食运动。

options.text: The talk focuses on classroom teaching methods.
options.feedback: 研究对象是年轻人,与教学方法无关。

rounds.speaker: 演讲者
rounds.line: Our results indicate that participants who slept for eight hours performed significantly better on the recall test.
rounds.lineCn: 我们的结果表明,睡了八小时的参与者在回忆测试中表现显著更好。

grammar.name: 结果呈现句式
grammar.note: results indicate that... 是报告结果的常用学术句式;who slept for eight hours 是定语从句修饰 participants。

options.text: Eight hours of sleep led to better performance on the recall test.
options.feedback: 八小时睡眠组在回忆测试中表现更好。

options.text: Lack of sleep improved the participants' recall performance.
options.feedback: 结果是八小时睡眠表现更好,而非缺觉。

options.text: Sleep duration had no effect on the test results.
options.feedback: 睡眠时长显著影响了测试表现。

rounds.speaker: 演讲者
rounds.line: It is worth noting that the improvement we observed appeared mainly in the group with consistent sleep schedules.
rounds.lineCn: 值得注意的是,我们观察到的改善主要出现在作息规律的群体中。

grammar.name: 限定性学术表述
grammar.note: It is worth noting that... 是谨慎而正式的学术句式;improvement we observed 省略 that 的定语从句。

options.text: The improvement mainly appeared in the regular-schedule group.
options.feedback: 改善主要集中在作息规律的那组。

options.text: Every group improved equally in the study.
options.feedback: 改善并非各组相同,而是集中于规律作息组。

options.text: Sleep schedules had no influence on the improvement.
options.feedback: 作息规律与否正是影响改善的关键。

rounds.speaker: 演讲者
rounds.line: Nevertheless, we acknowledge that the sample size remains modest, and future studies should include larger populations.
rounds.lineCn: 不过,我们承认样本量仍然有限,未来研究应纳入更大的群体。

grammar.name: 研究局限的委婉表达
grammar.note: Nevertheless + acknowledge that 承认局限,是学术演讲中增强可信度的标准句式。

options.text: The study admits its small sample and calls for larger research.
options.feedback: 演讲者承认样本有限,建议更大范围研究。

options.text: The sample is large enough to draw firm conclusions.
options.feedback: 演讲者明确指出样本量仍然有限。

options.text: No further research is needed on this topic.
options.feedback: 演讲者恰恰呼吁开展更多研究。

rounds.speaker: 演讲者
rounds.line: In conclusion, adequate sleep appears to play a crucial role in memory consolidation, and we encourage further investigation.
rounds.lineCn: 总之,充足的睡眠似乎在记忆巩固中起关键作用,我们鼓励进一步研究。

grammar.name: 演讲结论句式
grammar.note: In conclusion + appears to 的审慎语气 + encourage further investigation,是完整学术结论的固定套路。

options.text: The speaker concludes that sleep matters for memory and more research is needed.
options.feedback: 结论是睡眠对记忆重要,并呼吁继续研究。

options.text: The speaker concludes that sleep is harmful to memory.
options.feedback: 演讲者认为睡眠起关键积极作用。

options.text: The speaker concludes that the topic deserves no attention.
options.feedback: 演讲者鼓励进一步研究,十分重视该主题。
